description: Na₁₀Be₄Si₄O₁₇ crystallizes in the cubic P̅43m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.30 Å) and three longer (2.64 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.60 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.49 Å. Be is bonded to four O atoms to form BeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent BeO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.65 Å) and one longer (1.69 Å) Be-O bond length. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent BeO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.61 Å) and three longer (1.67 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent Be atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Be, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one Si atom.
